# Top Shelf Business Solutions

> Top Shelf Business Solutions is a Denton, Texas digital-modernization agency for local service businesses across the United States. We build a business its website and run it on our own all-in-one platform: an AI front desk that answers calls and chats 24/7, missed-call text-back, online booking, a CRM with automated follow-up, invoicing and card payments, automated review requests, and local SEO. The goal is simple: stop losing jobs to missed calls, slow follow-up, and a weak online presence. The customer owns their website, domain, phone number, Google Business Profile, review profiles, and contact list from day one; only the CRM software and its automations are subscribed.

## Plans and pricing
- [Pricing](https://www.topshelfsolutions.io/pricing.html): Three flat monthly plans, no setup fee, nothing up front. Essentials Blend $299/mo (website plus the get-found and get-booked foundations), Signature Blend $899/mo (most popular; adds the full CRM, AI receptionist, monthly SEO, and done-for-you review responses), Platinum Blend $2,500/mo (by application; adds managed ads, social, and email/SMS campaigns, with ad spend billed separately at cost). Plans are month to month and can be cancelled anytime. A custom 5-page website can also be bought on its own for $1,500 one-time with no plan.

## What we do
- [Websites and SEO](https://www.topshelfsolutions.io/solution-websites-seo.html): custom websites and local search optimization.
- [AI Phone and Chat](https://www.topshelfsolutions.io/solution-ai-phone.html): a receptionist that answers every call and message and books the job.
- [CRM and Follow-Up](https://www.topshelfsolutions.io/solution-crm.html): one organized database with automatic lead follow-up.
- [Reviews and Reputation](https://www.topshelfsolutions.io/solution-reviews.html): automated review requests and responses.
- [Marketing and Social](https://www.topshelfsolutions.io/solution-marketing.html): managed Google, social, and promotions.
- [Online Booking](https://www.topshelfsolutions.io/solution-booking.html): 24/7 self-serve scheduling.
- [Payments and Financing](https://www.topshelfsolutions.io/solution-payments.html): invoicing and card payments.
- [AI and Automation](https://www.topshelfsolutions.io/solution-automation.html): workflows that run the busywork.
- [Memberships and Loyalty](https://www.topshelfsolutions.io/solution-memberships.html): recurring plans and repeat-customer programs.
- [POS and Inventory](https://www.topshelfsolutions.io/solution-pos.html): point of sale and stock tracking, available as an add-on.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Company: Top Shelf Business Solutions LLC, Denton, Texas. Phone (469) 833-3033. Email contact@topshelfsolutions.io.
- The core differentiator: the customer owns their website, domain, number, reviews, and customer list, and keeps all of it if they ever leave. Only the software is rented. This is the opposite of platforms that hold a site or data hostage.
- One team, one bill: website, calls, CRM, reviews, ads, and POS are integrated rather than split across separate vendors.
